description: This Java class is a Spring MVC Controller named ClientController, handling web requests related to client management such as adding, editing, viewing details, and adding similar clients.

classes.name: ClientController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing client-related web requests such as add, edit, details, and add similar client.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Handles GET request to display form for adding a new client.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new client after form submission.

methods.name: editClient
methods.description: Handles GET request to display form for editing an existing client.

methods.name: seveClient
methods.description: Handles POST request to save changes to an existing client.

methods.name: clientDetails
methods.description: Handles GET request to display detailed information about a specific client, including contracts and events.

methods.name: addSimilarClient
methods.description: Handles GET request to display form for adding a client similar to an existing one.
